# lynxr

> lynxr turns a short-form video into a script. You paste a public link to a
> TikTok or Instagram video; it watches the video, transcribes what is said,
> works out the format underneath — the hook, the beats, the order they come
> in — and rewrites that format as a script for the company you are making
> content for.

lynxr is the UGC creator tool, built for UGC creators: people who make short-form videos for brands. It is made by lynxr LLC, a partner company of
Lynx Media Group LLC, the UGC agency in Allston, Massachusetts. The agency's site is https://lynxmediagroup.org/. Sign-up is open to everyone and free: every account gets
3 scripts a week, with no card required. The app lives at lynxr.io itself — paste a
link on the homepage and create an account when you send it. There is no file
upload: a public video link is the only input. It reads TikTok and Instagram
links. It never asks for a platform password and it never posts anything on
your behalf. You must be 18 or older to use it.

Not to be confused with: the Honeywell or Ademco LYNXR security control panels,
the Lynx R-1 or R2 mixed reality headsets, or lynxr.com. lynxr is at lynxr.io.

## Pages

- [lynxr](https://lynxr.io/): What lynxr is and how it works in three steps.
- [Questions and answers](https://lynxr.io/faq/): Straight answers about what lynxr does with a link, which platforms it reads, what it costs, who owns the scripts, and how access works.
- [Pricing](https://lynxr.io/pricing/): What lynxr costs. Free to start: 3 scripts in any rolling 7 days; no card required. lynxr pro is $24.99 a month for up to 150 scripts in any rolling 30 days and up to 30 in any 24 hours; tax is added where it applies. Post tracking of the TikTok and Instagram accounts you link is live on every plan. Coaching tips are coming soon: basic tips on free, advanced tips on pro, and the full coaching and advice on lynxr max ($74.99 a month), which is not on sale yet.
- [How scripts work](https://lynxr.io/how-it-works/): How lynxr gets from a public TikTok or Instagram link to a script: it transcribes the video, reads the frames shot by shot, and maps the format (the hook, the beats, the turn, the close), then writes it for your brand. Includes a before-and-after example.
- [The coach](https://lynxr.io/how-it-works/coach/): The content coach planned for every plan (basic tips on free, advanced tips on pro, the full coaching and advice on lynxr max). It is not built yet and lynxr max is not on sale; there is no date. Post tracking, which it will read, is already live on every plan; when the coach arrives it will match each tracked post to its script and tell you what to make next.
- [About lynxr](https://lynxr.io/about/): Who makes lynxr — lynxr LLC, a partner company of Lynx Media Group, the UGC agency.

- [How to write a hook](https://lynxr.io/how-to-write-a-hook/): The four hook shapes that keep working, and how to steal a hook's shape without stealing its words.
- [A UGC script template that holds up](https://lynxr.io/ugc-script-template/): The four-part template with a worked example, and the mistakes that make UGC read like an ad.
- [Remake a viral video without copying it](https://lynxr.io/remake-a-viral-video/): What to keep, what to replace, and the line between a remake and a copy.
- [UGC and short-form video glossary](https://lynxr.io/glossary/): Plain definitions of the terms lynxr uses.

## Blog

- [The lynxr blog](https://lynxr.io/blog/): Every post, grouped by topic.
- [Question hooks: asking one a viewer can't scroll past](https://lynxr.io/blog/question-hooks/): Question hook examples for UGC videos: why yes-or-no questions lose the viewer, how to ask an open one, and where the answer should land in the script.
- [The two-column script: SAY and DO side by side](https://lynxr.io/blog/two-column-script/): A blank two-column UGC script template: spoken words on the left, what the camera shows on the right, plus a filled example for a brand video.
- [How to script a storytime video for a brand](https://lynxr.io/blog/storytime-script/): How to write a storytime UGC script for a brand: the beat map of a storytime video, where the story should turn into the product, and which backstory to cut.
- [How to find a video worth remaking in your niche](https://lynxr.io/blog/find-a-video-worth-remaking/): How to find viral videos worth remaking as UGC for a brand: the signals to trust, where to look, a five-line test, and the red flags to skip.
- [How to turn a brand brief into a script](https://lynxr.io/blog/brief-to-script/): How to write a UGC script from a brief: mark what must and must not be said, pick the format before writing, and place brand lines so they do not sound recited.
- [Hook and payoff: why a strong hook still loses the viewer](https://lynxr.io/blog/hook-payoff/): A hook and its payoff have to match in a UGC video: what a payoff is, the three promise types, where the payoff lands, and how to fix a hook that over-promises.
- [How long should a UGC script be?](https://lynxr.io/blog/how-long-should-a-script-be/): How long should a UGC script be? Length follows the beat count, not a word count: a shape for short, medium and long scripts for brand videos.
- [How to write a POV video script](https://lynxr.io/blog/pov-video-script/): How to write a POV video script for a brand: who the camera is, what the POV: label says, a beat map, and where the product goes.

## Questions UGC creators ask

- [Getting started as a UGC creator](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-getting-started/): Short answers to the questions people ask before their first paid UGC job: what the work is, what a portfolio needs and what you need to start.
  - [What is a UGC creator?](https://lynxr.io/blog/what-is-a-ugc-creator/): What a UGC creator is, how the work differs from being an influencer, and what the day-to-day job of making short videos for brands looks like.
  - [Do you need followers to be a UGC creator?](https://lynxr.io/blog/do-you-need-followers-for-ugc/): Do you need followers for UGC work? Learn what a brand is paying for, when your own audience comes into a deal, and what to build instead of a following.
  - [What should a UGC portfolio include?](https://lynxr.io/blog/what-to-put-in-a-ugc-portfolio/): What to put in a UGC portfolio: sample videos in different formats, alternate hooks, a short intro and contact details, and what to leave out.
  - [How do you make UGC samples before any brand hires you?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-samples-without-a-brand/): How to build a UGC portfolio with no experience: make sample videos with products you own, write yourself a brief, and label every sample honestly.
  - [What equipment do you need to start making UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-equipment-to-start/): UGC equipment for beginners: the phone, light, sound, mount and background you need to start, what each one fixes, and what to hold off buying.
  - [Should UGC creators pick a niche?](https://lynxr.io/blog/should-ugc-creators-pick-a-niche/): Whether to choose a UGC niche: the trade-offs, how to pick product categories you really use, how a niche shapes your portfolio, and when to widen it.
  - [Can you make UGC without showing your face?](https://lynxr.io/blog/faceless-ugc/): Faceless UGC works when each video is built on your hands, voice or screen. Formats that suit it, how to check the brief, and how to script with no face.
  - [What skills does a UGC creator need?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-creator-skills/): The UGC creator skills worth building first, from scripting and hooks to delivery, light, sound and editing, and a simple way to practise each one at home.
  - [How do you practise UGC before your first paid job?](https://lynxr.io/blog/practise-ugc-before-first-job/): How to practise UGC before your first paid job: a weekly routine of scripting, filming and reviewing your own footage with products you already own.
  - [How do you get comfortable talking to the camera for UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/comfortable-on-camera-for-ugc/): Practical drills to feel comfortable on camera for UGC: talk to one real person, film in short takes, and rewatch with a checklist instead of a critic.
- [UGC rates, pay and usage rights](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-rates-and-pay/): How UGC creators get paid, how to work out a rate, and what usage rights, raw footage and whitelisting mean for the price.
  - [How do UGC creators get paid?](https://lynxr.io/blog/how-do-ugc-creators-get-paid/): How UGC creators get paid: flat fees per video, usage and raw footage add-ons, bundles, retainers, deposits, invoices and what to do when payment runs late.
  - [What are usage rights in UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/what-are-ugc-usage-rights/): UGC usage rights explained: organic versus paid use, how long and where a brand may run your video, and how to agree each term in writing first.
  - [How do you work out what to charge for a UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/how-to-set-ugc-rates/): How to charge for UGC with a method instead of a guess: price your time, the deliverables, usage and revisions, then build a base rate with add-ons.
  - [What is whitelisting in UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/what-is-whitelisting-in-ugc/): UGC whitelisting explained: a brand runs ads from your own handle. What access you give, what to agree in writing, and how it differs from usage rights.
  - [Should you charge extra for raw footage in UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/raw-footage-in-ugc/): Raw footage in UGC explained: what counts as raw files, why they let a brand cut more ads, and how to price and hand them over as a separate line.
  - [What should a UGC rate card include?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-rate-card/): What to put on a UGC rate card: the base video, extra hooks, raw footage, usage and rush lines, plus the terms that stop a quote turning into extra unpaid work.
  - [What should you agree in writing before a UGC job starts?](https://lynxr.io/blog/agree-in-writing-before-ugc/): A UGC contract checklist for creators: the deliverables, revision rounds, usage, deadlines, approvals and payment timing to confirm in writing before you film.
  - [How do you price a bundle of UGC videos?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-video-bundles/): How to build and price UGC video packages: what goes in a bundle, why shared work lowers the cost of each extra video, and which add-ons to price separately.
- [Finding UGC brand deals](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-brand-deals/): How to find brands that hire UGC creators, how to pitch them, what to send, how to follow up and how to get booked again.
  - [How do you write a UGC pitch email to a brand?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-pitch-email/): How to write a UGC pitch email: lead with one video idea for the brand's product, prove it with a portfolio link, ask clearly, and cut the rest.
  - [How do you find brands that hire UGC creators?](https://lynxr.io/blog/find-brands-for-ugc/): How to find UGC brands to pitch: spot the signs a brand already buys creator-style video, build a short target list, and decide where to send each pitch.
  - [What should you send a brand with a UGC pitch?](https://lynxr.io/blog/what-to-send-with-a-ugc-pitch/): What to send brands with a UGC pitch: the portfolio link, one matching sample, a hook idea for their product, rates only when asked, and what to leave out.
  - [How do you follow up when a brand doesn't reply to a UGC pitch?](https://lynxr.io/blog/follow-up-ugc-pitch/): How to follow up on a UGC pitch that got no reply: when to send it, what new thing to add each time, example follow-ups to copy, and when to stop.
  - [How do you get a brand to book you again for UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/get-rebooked-ugc/): How to turn one UGC job into repeat clients: deliver early and organised, add spare hook options, ask for feedback and pitch the next video with one idea.

  - [What makes a brand choose one UGC creator over another?](https://lynxr.io/blog/why-brands-pick-a-ugc-creator/): How to stand out as a UGC creator using signals you control: sharp hooks, clean audio, samples that follow a brief, clear replies and a delivery date you keep.
  - [How do you reply when a brand offers only free product?](https://lynxr.io/blog/reply-to-free-product-offer/): When a UGC brand offers free product instead of pay, decide what the offer is worth to you first, then send a short, polite reply you can copy and adapt.

  - [What goes in a UGC brief?](https://lynxr.io/blog/what-goes-in-a-ugc-brief/): What goes in a UGC brief: the parts to look for, how to read a brief before you script, and the questions to send a brand when something is unclear.
  - [What do you do when a UGC brief is vague?](https://lynxr.io/blog/vague-ugc-brief/): What to do with an unclear UGC brief: the questions to send back, how to propose two directions, and how to write your assumptions down before you film.
  - [What do you do when brand feedback would break the video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-feedback-that-breaks-the-video/): How to handle UGC brand feedback that would break your video: tell word changes from format changes, explain in one sentence, and offer an alternative.
  - [How should revisions work on a UGC job?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-revisions/): How UGC revisions work in practice: agree the rounds up front, get the script approved before filming, and tell a revision apart from a new video.
  - [What should you deliver at the end of a UGC job?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-deliverables/): A checklist of UGC deliverables to hand over at the end of a job: final cuts, hook variations, captions, clear file names and a short handover note.
  - [How do you name and send UGC files to a brand?](https://lynxr.io/blog/sending-ugc-files/): How to send UGC files to a brand: a file naming scheme that tracks drafts and versions, one folder per job, and a delivery link that keeps working.
  - [What do you do when a brand asks for changes after delivery?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-changes-after-delivery/): What to do when a brand asks for UGC changes after delivery: check what you agreed, sort small fixes from new work, and quote extra work politely.
- [Writing UGC scripts](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-scripts/): How to write UGC scripts for different kinds of product, from skincare to apps, with an example script in every answer.
  - [What goes in a UGC script for a skincare brand?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-script-for-skincare/): What a UGC script for a skincare brand needs: a hook built on a skin situation, the routine, texture on camera, an honest timeline, and the claims to leave out.
  - [How do you write a UGC script for an app?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-script-for-an-app/): How to write a UGC script for an app: build it around one moment on the screen, pair every spoken line with a phone shot, and skip the feature tour.
  - [How do you write a fitness UGC script without promising results?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-script-for-fitness-products/): How to write a fitness UGC script that films the routine, the effort and the product in use, with no body-change promises and an example script to adapt.
  - [How do you write a UGC script that doesn't sound scripted?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-script-that-sounds-natural/): How to write a UGC script that sounds natural: write for the mouth, read it aloud, choose word-for-word lines or talking points, and rehearse before you film.
  - [How do you write a call to action for a UGC ad?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-call-to-action/): How to write a UGC call to action that sounds earned: one ask tied to the last beat, wording for links, saves, comments and shopping, and lines to cut.
- [UGC hooks](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-hooks/): How to write the first seconds of a UGC video: hooks for ads, visual hooks, on-screen text and hook variations a brand can test.
  - [How many hooks should you film for one UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-hook-variations/): How many UGC hook variations to film for one video, what each variation should change, and how to film and deliver them all from one session.
  - [What makes a UGC hook work in an ad?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-ad-hooks/): What makes UGC ad hooks work for strangers: name the person and the situation in the first line, show the product's world, and keep the promise.
  - [How do you hook a UGC video when the product is in the first frame?](https://lynxr.io/blog/product-first-frame-hook/): A product video hook for when the product must be in the first frame: make it the question, hold back the result, and compare a weak and a strong script.
  - [What is a visual hook in UGC?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-visual-hooks/): What a visual hook is in UGC, with visual hook examples: how to write the opening shot as a filmable instruction, motion versus still, and a full script.
  - [How do you write a negative hook a brand will approve?](https://lynxr.io/blog/negative-hooks-ugc/): Negative hook examples for UGC that a brand will approve: aim at a habit or a mistake, never a person or a rival product, and pay it off within the video.
  - [How do you write on-screen text for a UGC hook?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-on-screen-text-hook/): How to write on-screen text for a UGC hook: add what the spoken line leaves out, keep it short enough to read, and make it work with the sound off.
- [Filming and editing UGC](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-filming/): How to film and edit UGC on a phone: light, sound, B-roll, product demos, captions and the shots a brand needs.
  - [How do you film UGC on a phone so it looks good?](https://lynxr.io/blog/film-ugc-on-a-phone/): How to film UGC on your phone so it looks good: clean the lens, choose the right camera, face the light, frame vertically, steady the phone, film extra takes.
  - [How do you light a UGC video at home?](https://lynxr.io/blog/light-ugc-at-home/): UGC lighting at home without a kit: face a window, switch off the room lights, keep one colour of light, and add a lamp only when daylight runs out.
  - [What B-roll should you film for a UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-b-roll/): What UGC B-roll to film: product, hands, setting and reaction shots, tied to each line of your script, plus spare clips that give the editor room.
  - [How do you get clear audio in a UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-audio/): UGC audio tips for clear sound on a phone: pick a soft room, keep the phone close, consider a clip-on mic, and check every take on headphones.
  - [How do you film a product demo so it looks real?](https://lynxr.io/blog/film-a-ugc-product-demo/): How to film a UGC product demo that looks real: one continuous take for the key moment, your hands in frame, everyday settings and results shown at real speed.
- [UGC video formats](https://lynxr.io/faq/ugc-formats/): One UGC format at a time: unboxing, GRWM, testimonial, problem-solution, before-and-after and more, each with its beats and an example script.
  - [What are the main types of UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/types-of-ugc-videos/): The main types of UGC videos, one line each: demo, unboxing, tutorial, testimonial, point of view and more, plus how to pick one for a brief.
  - [How do you script an unboxing UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-unboxing-video/): How to write an unboxing UGC script: open on the first look inside, keep the box short, film each layer as its own beat, and close on one ask.
  - [How do you script a get-ready-with-me UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-grwm-video/): How to script a get-ready-with-me UGC video: write the talk track as its own story, then place the product at the routine step where it belongs.
  - [How do you script a testimonial-style UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-testimonial-video/): How to write a testimonial UGC script from real use: what you expected, how you used it, an honest verdict with one downside, and an example script.
  - [How do you script a problem-solution UGC video?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-problem-solution-video/): How to script a problem-solution UGC video: make the problem visible before the product appears, bring it in at the turn, and close on what you noticed.
  - [How do you script a before-and-after UGC video honestly?](https://lynxr.io/blog/ugc-before-and-after-video/): How to script a before and after UGC video honestly: film both halves in the same light and angle, script the in-between, and never stage the after shot.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://lynxr.io/privacy/): What lynxr collects, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept, and how to have it deleted.
- [Terms of service](https://lynxr.io/terms/): What lynxr does, what you are responsible for, who owns the scripts, what is and is not promised, and when a payment is refunded.
- [Accessibility](https://lynxr.io/accessibility/): What works, and the specific things that do not work yet.
- [Refunds](https://lynxr.io/terms/#refunds): The refunds section of the terms of service. Cancelling lynxr pro at any time stops the next renewal. From 23 October 2026, cancelling within 48 hours of a payment, having written fewer than 10 scripts since, refunds that payment in full and ends pro, once per account; first payments made before then keep the 14-day money-back. No pro-rata refund otherwise. Stripe is the merchant of record.
